seo.title: Writing — Tamara Mack
seo.description: Statused essays, ADRs, and documentation-standard notes on building products, systems, and craft.

hero.title: Editorial grid
hero.lede: Statused essays, ADRs, and the documentation standard — not a flat blog list. Documentation is part of the definition of done.

essays.title: Documentation is the definition of done
essays.excerpt: No substantial feature is complete until requirements, architecture, security, operating behavior, and validation are written down.

essays.title: ADR-0001 Local-first architecture
essays.excerpt: Outbound access is explicitly permitted, never assumed. Models stay inside the private boundary.

essays.title: Agent permission boundaries
essays.excerpt: Financial agents analyze and propose. They cannot modify the ledger or execute payments.

essays.title: Implemented is not validated
essays.excerpt: Track design, implementation, tests, security review, and documentation as separate columns.

essays.title: Personal data never enters the product template
essays.excerpt: Core platform, private deployment, and product template stay on separate documentation tracks.
